# Everything about the new event: Packmules / Beasts of Burden

![All about the new event: Packhorse / Beasts of Burden](/uploads/167_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The “Pack Ass” event was introduced with the Patch 44 update on June 20, 2023. It is a **public event**, so it rotates with the other public events and starts on the hour, at 8 p.m. and 40 p.m. It's all about the Blue Ridge Caravan Company, as is the New Event: Healthy and Safe / Safe and Sound. The event takes place in the newly designed **Cranberry Glade** in Cranberry Bog. Here the name hasn't changed, but the place has been converted from an abandoned Mirelurk nest to a cultist camp. These cultists stole cargo from the Blue Ridge Caravan Company in a trade gone wrong and hid it here. The players' task is to help **Luca Costa** from the Blue Ridge Caravan Company retrieve the stolen cargo from this cultist camp before his father Vinny Costa finds out about it. At the end of the event you will meet the new **Cryptid Ogua**.

After a trade deal goes wrong, Luca Costa needs a little help. A group of local cultists stole his Brahmin and his load of homemade explosive devices. His Uncle Vinny won't like it when he finds out about it.

Be especially careful not to disturb the local wildlife - cultists have recently heard some strange noises coming from the nearby forest.

## Location: Cranberry Glade

Until Patch 44, the Cranberry Glade was just a deserted place where Mirelurks in particular felt at home. There you would always find a few Mirelurks, a Mirelurk Queen and a Mirelurk King. After Patch 44, Cranberry Glade is now a new **cultist camp** where the cultists hide the stolen cargo from the Blue Ridge Caravan Company in the "Packhorse" event. There are several treehouses and huts on the trees, connected to each other with hanging bridges and stands. There is a stable in the middle. The camp is lit with candles and torches everywhere.

![Cranberry Glade Cultist Camp](/uploads/nukaknights-event-beasts-of-burden-fallout76-22.04.2023-01-21-55.jpg) 

![Cranberry Glade Cultist Camp Overview](/uploads/nukaknights-event-beasts-of-burden-fallout76-22.04.2023-01-23-32.jpg) 

![Event: Pack mule in the Cranberry Glade](/uploads/nukaknights-event-beasts-of-burden-fallout76-01.05.2023-11-40-29.jpg) 

## Process

After arriving at the Cranberry Glade parking lot, Luca is waiting for us there to start the event after a briefing.

![Event: Packhorse - Luca Costa is waiting for us at the parking lot](/uploads/nukaknights-event-beasts-of-burden-fallout76-22.04.2023-01-43-49.jpg) 

Next, players need to run over to the Cultist Camp and collect **Luca's Explosives (8 pieces)** from the "**Cultist Saints**". These are stronger than normal cultists, wear power armor and are armed with flamethrowers or melee weapons. You also have to expect to get by without a stealth bonus, as the cultists have **heightened perception** during the event and hide e.g. as a command build doesn't work like that.

![Luca's explosives (8 needed)](/uploads/nukaknights-event-beasts-of-burden-fallout76-22.04.2023-01-22-38.jpg) 

Now attach Luca's explosive devices to all the marked doors of the stable in the middle and to the huts and tree houses around the outside.

![Event: Packhorse - Place Luca's explosives on the doors](/uploads/nukaknights-event-beasts-of-burden-place-lucas-explosive.jpg) 

After the doors are open, the goal is to get the **stolen cargo** from all huts and treehouses within **5 minutes** and load it onto the **Brahmin**, which is in the **shed in the middle**
